original.statement: Waypoint pod tolerations are now configurable using the Helm value `.Values.global.waypoint.tolerations`.

decision.reason: [ev-2eab23b55c81] says Waypoint pod tolerations can now be configured through `.Values.global.waypoint.tolerations`. The values snapshots show this key is missing from 1.23.4 [ev-2139315891c3] and present in 1.24.0 [ev-257bea760fce], so it is a newly added option. Only environments that set this key behave any differently after the upgrade, so values-key{global.waypoint.tolerations, set} is the narrowest condition that fits. The evidence shows no adverse effect for anyone, so the consequence stays none.
